minutes_text:
VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  TUESDAY, MARCH 26, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  Victor Hill, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called the meeting to order at 5:10 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich

Commissioners Absent: Smith

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance: Christina Boatwright, Resource Connections Division Officer, Nick Sramek,
Veteran (and chair of American Gold Star Manor board), Vic Hill (CD 5) and Jim Goodin (CD 1).

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Smith led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52730  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  February 14, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Shaknovich, seconded by
  Commissioner Antes, Laid Over. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Blanco, Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Smith

2.  24-52732  Recommendation to receive and file Chair’s report.

  Page 1 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  TUESDAY, MARCH 26, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Chair noted a Executive Order allocating additional funding and research for
  women’s health that the VA is going to take a lead on. Additional items the Chair
  covered are listed in Announcements (under Future Agenda Items).

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osborn, seconded by Commissioner
  Antes, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Blanco, Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Smith

3.  24-52733  Recommendation to receive and file Staff report.

  Staff reminded Commissioners to complete their required Ethics Training and Form
  700 and thanked everyone for attending the Veteran Town Hall on March 13. Staff
  reminded Commissioners to join the planning subcommittee for Honoring Our
  Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony on 5/26, which meets online on Fridays at 3 p.m. and
  to mark their calendars for several Memorial Day events such as Fleet Week and a
  commemoration at American Gold Star Manor on 5/24. Nominations for the
  banners program continues through March 31.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osborn, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Blanco, Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Smith

4.  24-52734  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners pilot program.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Contreras, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6 Blanco, Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich
  No:  0 None

  Page 2 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  TUESDAY, MARCH 26, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Smith

PUBLIC COMMENT

Nick Sramek from American Gold Star Manor commented on the Veteran Town Hall presented by the
County of Los Angeles (Janice Hahn’s office) and the Military Veterans Affairs at American Gold Star
Manor on March 13. It was well-done and well-attended.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Fri. 3/29 – Vietnam War Vets. Day Event 8:30 to 1:30 at VA LB Patriot Park. Thurs. 4/18 – Veterans
Health & Resource Fair 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at Long Beach City College (Liberal Arts Campus). Weds.
5/1 to Sun. 5/5 – Sky Resilience Training in-person (meditation and breathing workshop for Veterans
and their friends and families) taking place at Century Villages at Cabrillo.

 Future Agenda Items: Create a budget and ask for additional funding for FY 2025 (April), Working
with City to replace Commissioners timing out July 1, Annual Report (due on June30), Review of
updates to Municipal Code 2.18 (City Commissions). The Community Crisis Team will present at a
future Commission meeting. Approximately 13 percent of its responses involve Veterans.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:04 p.m.
